name: Simulating Atmospheric Entry
description: A study in simulating atmospheric entry with a grid-based fluid solver, written up as a full report. The 3D C++ build stayed an early prototype; the 2D Python version shows the flow.
highlights: Ported a 2D Eulerian fluid solver to C++ and extended it to 3D
Atmosphere model: air density at any altitude from gravity, temperature lapse rate and gas composition
Voxelizes any .obj mesh with ray casting, so the air can flow around the object's real shape

media.caption: C++ version: an .obj model inside the 3D pressure field
